messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
As of which date are Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which cover the notification of conformity assessment bodies, applicable?

response.text: A partire da quale data si applicano gli articoli da 26 a 42 del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, che riguardano la notifica degli organismi di valutazione della conformità?
